addon_confirm.title: Matrix Bridge add-on found
addon_confirm.description:
The {addon} add-on was found at {host}. Its settings will be read directly from the add-on, so there is nothing to enter here.

All configuration lives in the add-on's Configuration tab.

manual.title: Connect to the Matrix Bridge add-on
manual.description: Enter the add-on's address and API token. You will see this when Home Assistant is not running supervised, when the add-on is on another machine, or when the add-on is running but Supervisor is not serving its API token — in which case the address below is already filled in and only the token is needed.

data_description.host: The add-on hostname. For a locally installed add-on this is local-matrix-bridge.
data_description.token: Shown in the Matrix panel under Settings → API token.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the API token
reauth_confirm.description: The Matrix Bridge add-on rejected the stored token. Enter the current one from the Matrix panel, under Settings → API token.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the add-on. Check that it is running and that the host and port are correct.
error.invalid_auth: The add-on rejected this API token.

abort.already_configured: This Matrix account is already set up.
abort.addon_not_running: The Matrix Bridge add-on is installed but not running. Start it, then try again.
abort.reauth_failed: Could not re-read the add-on's details from Supervisor. Check that the add-on is running.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Sends a text message to a Matrix room.

send_image.name: Send image
send_image.description: Sends a picture to a Matrix room, encrypting it when the room is encrypted.

path.name: Path
path.description: Local file path, which must be inside the add-on's allowed upload paths.

url.name: URL
url.description: URL to fetch the image from instead of a local path.

caption.name: Caption
caption.description: Optional message sent after the image.

send_file.name: Send file
send_file.description: Sends any file to a Matrix room.

path.name: Path
path.description: Local file path, which must be inside the add-on's allowed upload paths.

url.name: URL
url.description: URL to fetch the file from instead of a local path.

caption.name: Caption
caption.description: Optional message sent after the file.

react.name: React
react.description: Adds an emoji reaction to a message.

room.name: Room
room.description: Room ID or alias to join.

start_verification.name: Start verification
start_verification.description: Starts emoji verification with another device.

user_id.name: User ID
user_id.description: The Matrix user whose device to verify.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: Optional when the user has exactly one unverified device.

confirm_verification.name: Confirm verification
confirm_verification.description: Confirms that the emoji match on both devices.

transaction_id.name: Transaction ID
transaction_id.description: From the verification event or notification.

cancel_verification.name: Cancel verification
cancel_verification.description: Cancels a verification, signalling that the emoji did not match.

transaction_id.name: Transaction ID
transaction_id.description: From the verification event or notification.

set_device_trust.name: Set device trust
set_device_trust.description: Directly marks a device as verified, unverified or blacklisted without the emoji exchange.
